description: This file defines the MAX_Plugin class, a static helper class for managing plugins in the Revive Adserver project. It includes methods for loading, instantiating, configuring, caching, and managing plugin files and classes.

classes.name: MAX_Plugin
classes.description: A static helper class for plugin management, including loading, instantiation, configuration, and caching of plugins.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of a plugin class based on module, package, and optional name.

methods.name: _isEnabledPlugin
methods.description: Checks if a plugin is enabled based on configuration and module.

methods.name: _includePluginFile
methods.description: Includes the plugin PHP file given module, package, and name.

methods.name: _getPluginClassName
methods.description: Generates the expected class name for a plugin based on module, package, and name.

methods.name: getPlugins
methods.description: Returns an array of plugin objects from a specified module or module/package.

methods.name: _getPluginsFiles
methods.description: Returns a list of plugin files in a module or module/package.

methods.name: _getPluginsFilesFromDirectory
methods.description: Returns plugin files from a directory matching the plugin file mask.

methods.name: _getFileMask
methods.description: Returns the regex pattern used to match plugin files.

methods.name: callStaticMethod
methods.description: Calls a static method on a plugin class after including the plugin file.

methods.name: callOnPlugins
methods.description: Runs a specified method on all plugin objects in an array.

methods.name: factoryPluginByModuleConfig
methods.description: Creates a plugin instance based on configuration data for a module.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Reads and parses plugin configuration files.

methods.name: getConfigFileName
methods.description: Returns the path to a plugin's configuration file.

methods.name: getConfigByFileName
methods.description: Reads and parses a specific configuration file.

methods.name: copyDefaultConfig
methods.description: Copies default plugin config to the active config location.

methods.name: writePluginConfig
methods.description: Writes plugin configuration data to a file, creating fake configs for multi-host setups.

methods.name: _mkDirRecursive
methods.description: Recursively creates directories with specified permissions.

methods.name: prepareCacheOptions
methods.description: Builds cache options for a plugin's cache files, creating cache directories if needed.

methods.name: saveCacheForPlugin
methods.description: Saves data to a plugin cache file.

methods.name: getCacheForPluginById
methods.description: Retrieves cached data for a plugin by ID.

methods.name: cleanPluginCache
methods.description: Deletes cached plugin data.
